stemMd: A motor lifts a 40 kg load vertically by 3 m in 6 s at constant speed. Taking g=10 m/s squared and ignoring losses, what is its average power?
explanationMd: The work is mgh=40 times 10 times 3=1200 J. Divide by 6 s to obtain 200 W. Constant speed means no net kinetic-energy change.

distractorRationale.e: This is the work's numerical value, not power.
distractorRationale.c: This uses mass rather than energy per time.
distractorRationale.b: This multiplies work by time instead of dividing.
